# winit 0.30.13 vendor baseline

The source is the published `winit` 0.30.13 crate from crates.io (archive SHA-256
`a6755fa58a9f8350bd1e472d4c3fcc25f824ec358933bba33306d0b63df5978d`, the checksum `Cargo.lock`
carried before the override). Its upstream repository revision is recorded in
`vendor/winit/.cargo_vcs_info.json`; the crate is Apache-2.0 licensed. `src/`, `Cargo.toml`,
`LICENSE`, `README.md`, `build.rs` and `.cargo_vcs_info.json` are copied unchanged; the crate's
examples, tests and docs are not.

The baseline carries no behavioural change. Every change is one of the numbered patch files that
follow, each marked `WordCraft patch` in the source.
